title: Merge duplicate Completion/CompletionEvent DataClass groups in user_database_managers_test.dart
why: 'Completion DataClass + managers' (line 431-489) and 'CompletionEvent DataClass + managers' (line 493-549) both insert a CompletionEventsCompanion, fetch it back via db.managers.completionEvents, and assert toJson/fromJson/copyWith/equality/hashCode/toString/toCompanion/copyWithCompanion on the exact same generated class — under two names, one of which ("Completion") is the pre-rename table name that test/helpers/drift_memory.dart documents as dropped ("NOTE (W3.20): The `completions` legacy table was dropped"). ~60 lines of redundant assertions run on every CI pass for zero incremental coverage, and a reader cannot tell whether the split is deliberate (e.g. with/without trackId) or a leftover from the rename.
recommendation: Delete one group (or merge into one using current completionEvents/CompletionEvent terminology); if both variants are intentionally kept to cover trackId-present vs trackId-absent, add a one-line comment saying so.
acceptance_criteria: Only one group asserts the CompletionEvent DataClass round-trip, or a comment explains why two remain.
